scope: Research triage using the existing annual quality/value model; thresholds are design choices, not empirically validated suitability rules.
holding_review: Flag complete-evidence financial/sector/risk failures, purchase exclusions, short horizon or direct concentration breaches for review. Never turn rank removal alone into a sell.
hold: Existing exact-symbol holding meets the supported research rules and entered constraints, regardless of top-ten rank.
purchase: Only an unheld baseline-selected company passing entered constraints may receive its original cent amount. Withheld amounts remain cash; no replacement or reoptimization.
costs_and_taxes: No liquidation or net sale proceeds computed. Acquisition lots, account type, holding period, fees and applicable taxes require separate review.
